purpose: Post-evaluation diagnostic baselines computed from retained source confusion/per-image truth counts. No retraining, model selection or threshold change.
interpretation: The learned model exceeds constant-road five-class macro IoU but loses road/ROI IoU and pixel accuracy. Its zero pothole overlap and worse all-image area error than an empty mask mean it cannot support reliable ROI/damage measurement. Class imbalance makes average area error and pixel accuracy misleading alone.
limits: All numbers conditional on one source-heldout sequence. No independent physical/healthy labels, ground area, uncertainty calibration or deployment validation.
